status: fresh diagnostic preregistration; no reuse or resurrection of rejected screen
question: Broad controller dependence of the entire fixed retained-download vector
control_inclusion: Independent of throughput and every mature performance failure. Keep those failures and mature acceptance false; diagnostic eligibility is distinct.
structural_stop: Any integrity, conditioning, resource, lifecycle, controller-binding or strict outer-ownership failure stops remaining traffic.
candidate_stop: Reno must have mature accepted true and no performance issues, and every original download rate must meet its floor; failure is recorded in an ineligible arm decision and stops.
whole_cohort: Run all3arms whenever structural and candidate-floor eligible. No early11/14 effect gate. Compare effects only after all3.

primary.read: Sum all4upstream_read.total_ns; candidate strictlypositive and strictly below BOTH control sums
primary.no_regression: For EACH retained sequence candidate rate >=0.95 * max(corresponding control0 rate,control2 rate)

reports: All16rates; all4retained Read/Write/wall/handler durations; all3pooledrates and Reads; pooled and per-sequence ratios; every mature control performance failure; explicit diagnostic eligibility vs mature performance acceptance.
fixed_inputs: Exact existing16row workload,256MiB80ms8MiBpool,H2,same controller hook,observers,CPU/network/resource policies,certificate and acceptedbuildreceipt/binaries. Joined-ps wrapper is unchanged.
interpretation_limit: Broad workload controller dependence only; no production CC recommendation,HyStart proof,original96-transfer,HAProxy,parity,merge/release clearance.
numerical_method: Fractions.Fraction of already validated integer/IEEEfloat rates; exact harmonic pools and integer108/100 and95/100 comparisons; no epsilon. Floats only for display. Read sums remain integers.
